title: Make the provisioned Linux Vulkan SDK glslang include lookup case-tolerant
body: Fresh gpuyield configure: cmake --preset vixen-wsl -S VIXEN -B build/gpuyield -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy printed Fatal Error: glslang directory not found at x86_64/Include/glslang although provisioning supplies x86_64/include/glslang. Recovery uses the documented worktree-local ln -s include VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1/x86_64/Include and reconfigures through the live queue. Resolve the actual SDK include directory in provisioning/finder rather than requiring manual casing aliases.

title: Size VIXEN queued build credits from the requested compiler parallelism
body: gpuyield-baseline-apps-checks requested resource build with cmake --build build/gpuyield --parallel 4 and stayed queued for more than twelve minutes needing three CPU tokens, with only one available. The owned waiting wrapper was cancelled before any target ran (exit 143, inconclusive baseline). The documented recovery --resource build --credits 1 with --parallel 2 admitted immediately and is compiling fresh targets under the live queue and its unchanged memory gate. Derive the admission request from explicit build parallelism, or publish a supported low-footprint VIXEN entry point, instead of requiring a manual credits override.

title: Derive compute pipeline dispatch-base capability from bounded command recording
body: R477 tiles use vkCmdDispatchBase, but ComputePipelineCacher has no declared dispatch capability to derive VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_DISPATCH_BASE_BIT. This lane must add the flag manually to every cached compute pipeline. Consolidate pipeline capability derivation with graph command requirements; preserve compatible cached pipelines without a parallel registry.

title: Preserve compute builtin dependencies in the existing shader reflection contract
body: R477 must perform a separate SPIRV-Reflect module inspection to avoid changing gl_NumWorkGroups in generic compute shaders. Existing SpirvReflectionData/cache metadata discards this dependency, so dispatch code cannot derive tile eligibility from its ordinary bundle metadata. Consolidate consumed builtin IDs into the existing reflection result and cache format, then derive dispatch/pipeline capability from that result.

title: Make zero-count Vulkan submit payload copies safe without pointer arithmetic
body: The existing SubmitRecord adapter formed pointer+0 ranges even when Vulkan permits a null array pointer with count zero. The new semaphore-only completion test required manual guards for every optional array. Consolidate zero-count handling in the existing native payload adapter conventions so producers do not need caller-side fake storage.

title: Make CodeGraph first queries usable in isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The required first query, codegraph explore --path . --max-files 4 GPU submission dispatch frame pacing timestamp, exited 1 because this isolated worktree had no CodeGraph index. A second wrapper query also had no index. The lane continued its read-only inventory with rg rather than running an expensive new index. Publish or reuse a matching content-addressed index for lane worktrees, or make the mandated first query expose a supported lightweight fallback.

title: Share configured Vulkan runtime environment with standalone GPU witness tools
body: The R477 second-client witness needed a manually written worktree-local runtime-env.sh, sourced before tools/measure-gpu-cadence.py, exporting VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/home/liory/.cache/vixen/wsl-vulkan/dzn_icd.json and LD_LIBRARY_PATH entries for the provisioned Vulkan loader, Dozen and windowing libraries. CTest already derives this environment, and the windowed capture script duplicates its derivation, but the standalone native probe cannot consume it. Expose the existing configured runtime environment to witness commands so new probes do not hand-maintain SDK, driver and loader paths.

title: Declare CPU concurrency requirements for mixed GPU RenderGraph suites
body: The fresh merged full command, with-test-lock.sh --agent gpuyield --resource gpu --credits 1 -- env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH ctest --test-dir build/gpuyield -L RenderGraph|SVO --output-on-failure --parallel 1, received two CPU cores. FramePipelineTest.AdjacentFramesOverlapButCommitInSubmissionOrder failed with maxActive=1: two queued TBB tasks serialized while the caller waited. The unchanged fresh test_rendergraph_coresystems_b binary passed the same filtered test with --resource test --credits 2 (four cores), max concurrency assertion intact. FramePipeline.h, TaskExecutor.cpp and this fixture are unchanged from 5da61a18. Convey the suite CPU concurrency requirement to the queue from existing test metadata instead of discovering an extra credits override manually.

title: Require registered CTest launcher scripts to be tracked and present
body: After merging wave 742fddb6 into a5cc7f33, the required RenderGraph test vixen_multiinstance_cache_gate immediately failed: python3.14 cannot open VIXEN/tools/multiinstance_cache_gate.py (ENOENT). Neither that path nor repository-root tools/multiinstance_cache_gate.py exists, and git ls-tree of the latest fetched wave contains no corresponding script. VIXEN/.gitignore:80 ignores tools/. The registered CMake command cannot be repaired by changing paths or regenerating code; its handwritten launcher was omitted from the merge. Require configuration to validate registered script presence and tracked ownership, and have the owner land the intended launcher with git add -f or an appropriate ignore exception. Do not manufacture a weaker substitute test or silently disable the gate.

title: Windows native build discovery rejects an installed MSVC toolchain
body: Queued build.bat configure vixen-ninja exited 1: vswhere returned no registered C++ installation, although cl.exe and vcvars64.bat exist under the provisioned 17.14.41 BuildTools path. The standalone native probe compiled after calling that vcvars64.bat directly. Consolidate provisioner verification and launcher discovery so a provisioned toolchain is discoverable through the normal entry point.

title: Windows native CMake builds need a supported worktree drive mapping
body: Queued native configure through run_configure_locked.ps1 failed the MSVC compiler link probe because Ninja invoked cmd.exe from the WSL UNC binary directory. pushd to the assigned worktree supplied a temporary drive and let the compiler probe pass. Make the native launcher own that mapping for configure and build, and retain a stable mapping throughout each job.

title: Native Windows FetchContent needs scoped trust for WSL worktree clones
body: Mapped native configure failed cloning glm: Git for Windows rejected the native-fetch/glm-src WSL-share checkout as dubious ownership. Recovery uses process-local GIT_CONFIG_COUNT with safe.directory scoped to this worktree native-fetch/*, without a global trust change. Consolidate native dependency setup and scope trust to the provisioned worktree cache.

title: Native Windows configure should not attempt WSL Dozen provisioning
body: The native MSVC configure attempted bash Z:/.../cmake/provision-wsl-vulkan.sh and failed 127 because the mapped Windows path could not be translated. The native preset recovery explicitly uses VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_WSL_VULKAN=OFF. Derive platform provisioning from the target platform before project() instead of relying on the host WSL presence.

title: GPU CTest reservations bypass the queue device mutex
body:
Native cadence probes admitted under resource gpu overlapped live VIXEN processes belonging to queued test jobs: editormaterials vixen_lookdev_capture and togglelatency VIXEN; both were observed via /proc exe/cgroup while vmwp GPU Engine counters exceeded 100%. with-test-lock.sh acquires the GPU mutex only for resource gpu or exclusive jobs. A short exclusive peer repeat is required to isolate the measurement. Declare GPU usage for registered GPU tests and enforce it across test/gpu reservations; do not infer isolation from resource gpu alone.
Final witness consequence: --resource gpu --credits 15 --exclusive queued while ordinary GPU tests held test tokens. A later same-agent --resource test --credits 1 CPU ABI check yielded to that queued request. The owned, not-yet-started GPU request was cancelled (143), the CPU check passed (0), and the GPU request was requeued. Derive per-phase resource ownership so CPU contract validation precedes exclusive driver admission and all GPU tests participate in the same device lock.

title: Native codegen discovery needs the provisioned kernel root
body: After native compiler and dependency recovery, queued configure failed in VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake because YEROKET_ROOT defaulted to /Github/Yeroket-Fantasy. Recovery passes the read-only kernel UNC root explicitly and keeps VIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR inside the assigned worktree. Derive the native provider root and per-worktree cache as part of the existing provisioning contract.

title: GPU chunk timings need separate dependency and dispatch intervals
body: ComputeDispatchNode starts its existing chunk timestamp at TOP_OF_PIPE before the acquire wait and image/entry barriers, so the submission interval can include waiting unrelated to shader execution. This lane adds a COMPUTE_SHADER pair immediately around vkCmdDispatchBase, retains the original full interval and budget gate, and logs both through the existing query class. Consolidate these spans into the shared GPU profiling contract so diagnostics do not require per-node manual timestamp wiring.

title: MultiDispatch timestamp commands lie outside the primary recording lifetime
body: Inventory for R477 found BeginFrame/start queries before RecordDispatches begins the command buffer and an end query after it ends. These cannot establish per-pass GPU duration. Consolidate query placement into the existing command recording lifecycle, including chunk boundaries, and verify with validation enabled. Source audit only; no incidental repair yet.

title: Native build summary needs worktree-scoped logs and status
body: run_build_with_summary.ps1 defaults its shared status and per-build log to Windows TEMP. The isolated lane has to pass process-local TEMP/TMP pointing to its own .tmp/gpuyield-run2/native-temp to keep artifacts in the authorized worktree. Consolidate build artifact roots with the existing explicit BuildDir/BuildId contract.

title: Box queue native interop cleanup leaves Windows payload descendants alive
body: Queued run2-native-kernel-root exited 75/STALL_KILLED after 230s with Linux CPU idle, but owned Windows cmake PID 3444 and PowerShell PID 3940 survived. Their command lines were checked and they were explicitly stopped. Native runners need Windows child ownership/cleanup and progress accounting; the WSL process-group cleanup cannot cover those descendants. Diagnostic native file-lock check will precede recovery.

title: Dozen cadence queries need explicit availability waits and durable CSV rows
body: The isolated 500-frame VIXEN producer completed with 32000 valid chunks, but gpu-cadence-probe failed read timestamps with VK_NOT_READY after a successful fence wait and left a truncated final CSV row. Read the retired queries with VK_QUERY_RESULT_WAIT_BIT, report query-read latency separately, and flush each complete CSV row. This is diagnostic recovery rather than a weaker GPU budget gate.

title: Native CMake file locks stall on the assigned WSL worktree
body: Native configure stopped at VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake file(LOCK). A separate native cmake -P probe used a fresh worktree-local file and TIMEOUT 5, but never returned a result and was killed by the box queue after 199s. Owned surviving Windows processes were explicitly stopped. Native VIXEN needs a supported lock/cache route for WSL-backed worktrees, or an explicitly assigned NTFS worktree; do not bypass the pinned generation contract.

title: Filtered contract witnesses must reject zero selected tests
body: The first queued filtered run reached an older executable while its rebuild was active: test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_pushconstant --gtest_filter=RayGenerationTileContract.* exited 0 after running zero tests. That result is retained as invalid. Recovery waits for the build to complete and checks --gtest_list_tests for every required case before running it. Consolidate build-artifact dependencies and selected-test-count validation in the witness runner.

title: Anchor compiled shader fixtures to their owning checkout
body: run2-fresh-contract-tests failed because the new ray ABI test interpreted CMake's relative __FILE__ from the launcher cwd and compiled main-checkout VoxelRT.rgen, which lacks tileOrigin. The fixture now receives the existing VIXEN_SHADER_SOURCE_DIR through its target compile definitions, so neither repository-root nor CTest launches can escape the lane shader tree. Consolidate a shader-source-root binding for source-compiling fixtures.

title: Consolidate chunk retirement with declared graph timeline capacity
body: R477's cap currently calls vkQueueWaitIdle before each SubmitRecord chunk in Core/SubmitChannel.cpp. This is a handwritten queue-owner retirement step because the existing submit payload and graph capacity contract do not derive an outstanding-chunk limit or retirement token. R478 can consolidate it with graph-derived timeline dependencies, preserving first-wait/final-signal ownership and avoiding per-chunk host blocking; no new scheduling registry is needed.

title: Declare conservative uncalibrated GPU cost at the queue policy boundary
body: MultiDispatchNode now manually replaces zero or unavailable estimates with its full TaskQueue frame budget in QueueDispatch/TryQueueDispatch; mandatory work remains accepted. The existing generic queue/profile contracts have no GPU-specific unknown-cost policy, so this safety rule lives in node bodies. Consolidate the fallback from existing GPU capacity/profile declarations while preserving generic CPU TaskQueue zero-cost semantics.

title: Preserve integer vector traits in the shared SPIR-V reflection contract
body: The compiled VoxelRT.rgen ABI witness failed because INT|VECTOR flags became BaseType::Vector with width zero. The typed tile contract needs UInt/Int scalar kind, width, vector byte size and C++/GLSL vector names. Consolidate these traits in shared reflection instead of requiring each GPU node to reinterpret raw SPIR-V flags.

title: Queue wrapper termination leaves its nested Linux witness scope running
body: The queued run2-final-controlled-witness command returned 143 at 17:10 UTC, with no recorded final job status, but its systemd scope run-p155810-i21126088.scope continued running editor-after.sh and cmake --build build/gpuyield --target codegen/all vixen_editor --parallel 4. At the checkpoint the lane verified ownership and sent SIGTERM to that process group. Propagate wrapper cancellation to nested scopes and retain one final status; the initiating termination cause remains unclassified.
